blocks.x: This is tape number three of the Percy Heath interview for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History project. My name is Eugene Holley. The engineer is Sven Abow. We’re here at the great home of Mr. Percy Heath in Montauk, New York, July 23, 2001.
The modest home. The modest home in paradise.
